cases.sentence: Он вставал рано утром и становился у обочины дороги, которая вела к ___.
cases.explain: «городским воротам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”

cases.sentence: Там же был и Цадок, и левиты, сопровождавшие его и несущие ковчег ___.
cases.explain: «Божьего завета» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up, until all the people finished passing out of the city.

cases.sentence: А Давид пошел вверх по ___, плача на ходу; он шел босым, и голова его была покрыта.
cases.explain: «Масличной горе» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered, and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

cases.sentence: Но если ты вернешься в город и скажешь Авессалому: «Я буду ___, царь.
cases.explain: «твоим слугой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then will you defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

cases.sentence: Прежде я был слугой твоего отца, но теперь я буду ___», — то сможешь помочь мне, расстроив совет Ахитофела.
cases.explain: «твоим слугой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then will you defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

cases.sentence: Передавай им все, что услышишь в ___.
cases.explain: «царском дворце» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
